HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Mavhidhiyo akavakirwa pakutenda anobva muraibhurari yedu, kuti akukurudzire, akudenhe, uye akuitise kufungisisa.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Mangwanani akanaka! Nguva dzeBhaibheri dzanhasi dzakakumirira.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Tanga zuva rako nenguva dzeBhaibheri dzinokurudzira, dzakagadzirirwa kukusimbisa nekusimudza mweya wako.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Masikati akanaka! Nguva dzeBhaibheri dzezuva rako.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Zvirimo zveBhaibheri zvinokurudzira, zvakakodzera pakuzorora kwako kwemasikati kana kuti kuramba uchikurudzirwa.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Nguva dzeBhaibheri dzine runyararo dzinokubatsira kufungisisa nekuwana nyaradzo zuva rako parinopera.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Goho rasvika. Batana nesu tichiparidza Evhangeri kunyika yose tichishandisa midhiya yedhijitari.
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Kuti vanzwe uye vaone rudo rwaJesu mumutauro wavo, ipapo pavari.

Mission.headline: Shoko harichinji. Maonero evanhu ndiwo anochinja.
Mission.intro: Tiri kuvaka patsva raibhurari yedu yemavhidhiyo nezvishandiso kubva pakutanga, tichiisa makore mazhinji ebasa reshanduro pamapuratifomu ayo vanhu vatove kuungana, kutarisa nekugoverana.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Raibhurari yemafirimu yakashandurirwa mitauro yakawanda kupfuura dzimwe pasi rose
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Makore mazhinji ebasa reshanduro, akaitwa nevadyidzani vehushumiri vakavimbika, akavaka raibhurari ine zviuru zvemitauro yekuteerera, kuitira kuti vanhu vasangane nenyaya yaJesu mumutauro unovasvika pamwoyo zvakadzama.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Kuendesa manzwi anovimbwa nawo mumaitiro matsva
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Tiri kuvaka patsva maitiro ekutaurwa kwenyaya dzeEvhangeri nemifananidzo, tichibatanidza shanduro dzakavimbika nemaitiro emazuva ano, kuitira kuti shoko rifambe zvakasununguka pamapuratifomu, patsika, nepamaskrini akasiyana.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project chikwata chepasi rose chevashanduri, nyanzvi dzemidhiya, vapepeti, nevagadziri, vari kushandura makore mazhinji eruzivo rwehushumiri kuva zvishandiso zvevanoita vadzidzi kwese kwese.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Inobatanidza vaoni nemikana chaiyo parwendo rwavo rwemweya, ichivabatsira kutora danho rinotevera kuenda kunharaunda, kuMagwaro, kana kubasa.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Raibhurari yakakura yemidhiya yechiKristu ine zviuru zvemavhidhiyo, mafirimu nezvishandiso, zviripo mumitauro yakawanda, zvehushumiri nekuparidza Evhangeri pasi rose.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Kutonga mavhidhiyo, kugovera zvirimo, kubatana nevaoni, uye kuongorora nhamba, zvakagadzirirwa kubatsira hushumiri kusvika kuvanhu vakawanda zvinobudirira.
Mission.inviteBody: Tiri kukoka vashandi vebasa, vagadziri, nevadyidzani kuti vatange kushandisa zvishandiso zvitsva. Edza zvishandiso zvitsva kutanga, tipe mhinduro, uye ubatsire kugadzira zvigadzirwa zvakagadzirirwa basa chairo reEvhangeri.
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Inovhura peji rebasa reJesus Film pachikamu chehurongwa hwemberi
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Inovhura fomu rekunyoresa beta mubhurawuza yako
